card.name: Range endpoints after a minimum value
card.fires_on: The word 'to', a dash, or the digit just after the lower number inside a parenthetical range such as '(range: 0.6 to 6 months)', mostly for onset time or duration or age.

modes.label: Range connector
modes.description: The 'to' or dash right after the lower bound of a range in parentheses.

modes.label: Digits inside the lower bound
modes.description: A digit or space within the start of the range, before the connector.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a '(range: low to high)' note where the upper limit is about to be given.
